Class HistoricalValidationKernel

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.HistoricalValidationKernel
public class HistoricalValidationKernel extends Object
Historical Telemetry Validation invalid input: '&' Multi-Metric Empirical Benchmark Kernel.

Loads and validates socio-economic, cliodynamic, ecological, and technological variables from standardized benchmark datasets (historical_cliodynamic_benchmarks.json) and prospective 1D trajectories via HistoricalBenchmarkDatasetRepository, evaluating goodness-of-fit statistics via BenchmarkStatisticalHelper.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeContinuousTemporalTolerance

      public static double computeContinuousTemporalTolerance(double year)
      Computes the continuous, differentiable \(C^1\) temporal confidence tolerance envelope \(\tau(t)\).

      Formula (AGENTS.md Â§11): \[\tau(t) = \tau_{\text{mod}} + \frac{\tau_{\text{paleo}} - \tau_{\text{mod}}}{1 + \exp\left(\frac{t - t_{\text{trans}}}{s_{\text{trans}}}\right)}\] with \(\tau_{\text{paleo}} = 0.50\) (50% relative uncertainty in prehistoric and ancient eras), \(\tau_{\text{mod}} = 0.05\) (5% asymptotic relative uncertainty in the modern satellite and census era), \(t_{\text{trans}} = 1200\text{ CE}\), and \(s_{\text{trans}} = 300\text{ years}\).

      Parameters:
      year - calendar year (BCE negative, CE positive)
      Returns:
      relative error tolerance fraction in [0.05, 0.50]
